what: NV runtime settings: levels, the whitelist, voltage orders, configurations, cards, timing, limits, the heater and the burst-drop thresholds. Read by nv/block.sh (through nvlib.py) and nv/reduce.py; DESIGN.md explains every value. The predictions and decision rules are in predictions.json, fixed before the first card write; development may change only timing_s, limits, heater and analysis here.
min_bl2_why: BL2 0.18.0 (da192816a) writes every NoC set to the asset-config flash sector as the boot voltage (pwr_svc_set_module_voltage -> flash_fs_set_vmin_lut_boot_voltages, added 5f5c37abf, removed dd8927ce5 on 2024-04-05); 0.19.0 and later do not. block.sh's nv_set also refuses below 0.19.0, hard-coded.

aifoundry2.release_why: the card runs DV2's frozen validation (28 Sep); NV may use it only after DV2 ends and a person writes build/claims-v3/aifoundry2/nv/CARD-RELEASED with the owner's OK

refused_cards.aifoundry1-c1: BL2 0.18.0: every NoC set would be written to the card's flash as its boot voltage (DESIGN.md §2); and on a two-card host the stock dev_mngt_service opens card 0's management node too

heater.what: E42's heater on a governor-free card (lib.sh GOV_FREE): heat to heat_c under the lock before the first set, and one 2 s launch before an idle window or a configuration whose die reads below warm_c
